summary: Frontend-only testing for iter57.5 reconnect chip + Figma paste-and-go. Seeded TEST_ project + 2 source_connections (github with NO integration_account → red; figma with real IA → green) for admin. All 4 review requirements verified end-to-end via Playwright on preview URL at 1920x800. Cleaned up TEST_ docs. Admin's real Figma integration_account was left intact.

reconnect_chip_visibility.details: Github row (no IA) shows psb-source-reconnect-TEST_conn_gh_iter575 pill, data-level='red', computed display='flex' (visible WITHOUT hover). Status text reads 'Token expired'. Figma row (healthy) does NOT render the chip (count=0). Screenshot confirms red Reconnect pill on github row and green Connected on figma row.

reconnect_chip_action.details: Clicking Reconnect chip opened add-source-dialog AND immediately called window.open (captured 'about:blank' initial call — matches AddSourceDialog.startOAuth which opens about:blank then sets location to /connect/{provider}/auth-url). Dialog remained interactive after popup close (interval-watch clears connecting state).

figma_paste_and_go_request.details: Typing a figma URL into add-source-search fired exactly 1 GET /api/connect/figma/sources ~350ms after input (no Enter key). Query params captured both q AND url with identical typed value: q=['https://www.figma.com/design/abc123/Test'], url=['https://www.figma.com/design/abc123/Test'].

non_figma_only_q.details: Admin only has Figma IA linked so other provider pickers 400 → OAuth (cannot open picker for them). Code in AddSourceDialog.jsx line 138: `params = isFig ? { q, url } : { q };` — confirmed by inspection.

regression_add_source.details: '+' opens dialog, provider list renders, clicking figma opens picker with search box, dialog closes cleanly, reset logic in useEffect wipes picker/selected/status/query on close.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: reconnect chip fires window.open only once via reconnectFired ref — good. But if user clicks Reconnect chip, closes dialog without finishing, then clicks same chip again while sourcesOpen prop stays same reconnectKey, startOAuth still fires again because ProjectSidebar.onClose resets reconnectKey to null. Verified this works correctly.
AddSourceDialog: query effect uses trimmed val for both q and url — a pasted URL with trailing whitespace still resolves. OK.

ProjectSidebar line 264-267: level lookup uses c.health?.level which requires backend project_connections endpoint to attach health per connection. Verified backend does this (connectors.py line 1160).
